messages:
Anna: Quick question — can we shrink the adapter surface for Private so it only exposes a minimal capability probe instead of the full manifest?
Mike: I think so, but what's the goal? smaller upgrade surface or fewer ops handoffs?
Anna: Both. Private installs often lag on feature parity. If adapter only needs to answer `capabilities()` and a small runtime-probe, we can keep hosted/dedicated feature rollout independent.
Jasper: :+1: sounds attractive but watch coupling. If `capabilities()` returns too many boolean flags we end up recreating the old surface.
Tara: Can we standardize a tiny schema instead? e.g., { runtime: "gpu|cpu", kv_cache: true, quant: "int8|fp16" } — simple enums, no opaque config blobs.
Mike: I like the enum idea. Also suggest a versioned probe endpoint: `/probe/v{n}` so adapters can evolve without breaking.
Anna: Agreed. Proposal: adapter must implement `/probe/v1` returning minimal JSON; control plane translates or synthesizes the richer manifest only on hosted/dedicated.
Jasper: One operational edge: Private customers sometimes require local tuning flags (e.g., affinity hints). If we hide those, ops lose control. How do we give controlled escape hatches?
Tara: Add a separate opt-in `localHints` map that is opaque to the control plane but surfaced to on-prem ops via the console. Default empty.
Mike: That keeps the control-plane surface tiny while preserving admin knobs. Also avoids exposing secrets in the probe payload.
Anna: Good call. Security note: probe must not contain any secrets or keys. OpsBot: deploy-bot posted: "Staged config: probe-endpoint-featureflag enabled for canary tenants"
Jasper: For rollout, how about an adapter compatibility matrix checked at onboarding? small tool: `adapter-compat check --target private --probe ./out.json`
Tara: We should also add telemetry keys to see how often control plane needs to materialize hosted-only features for Private (so we know when to expand the probe).
Anna: Action items: 1) spec `/probe/v1` JSON schema, 2) add `localHints` opt-in, 3) implement `adapter-compat` CLI check, 4) telemetry ping. I'll file the RFC follow-up.
Mike: I'll draft the open spec. Jasper/Tara can review for ops/telemetry.
Jasper: I'll add compatibility checks to the onboarding script.
Tara: I'll wire telemetry and console surface for `localHints`.
Anna: Thanks — will ping when RFC PR is up. :rocket:
OpsBot: incident-bot: No incidents reported.
Anna: FYI — timeline: aim for canary in 2 weeks, broad after 4 weeks if telemetry looks clean.
